role_and_message.evidence: The original strip-pooling versus average-pooling comparison at two incremental training steps remains.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All eight original panels remain in the same two-row/four-column order: two airplane photos, four predictions and two ground-truth masks.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Image, step2, step3 and GT headings retain their original column assignments; added row names accurately identify PLOP top and ours bottom.

connections_and_direction.evidence: No arrows are introduced; the row/column comparisons remain aligned to the same original image and steps.

visual_encodings.evidence: Every yellow strip/box annotation, dark-red predicted mask, white ground-truth boundary and original photograph color is preserved.

examples_and_data.evidence: All eight destination regions independently match exact 3x nearest-neighbor enlargements of original crops, including source and output pixel hashes.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The only new explanatory labels are Strip pooling(PLOP) and Average pooling(ours), explicitly stated by Figure5 caption. No inferred meaning is assigned to yellow markers.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All eight full regions and row/column labels remain visible without clipping; nearest enlargement preserves source resolution limits.

remaining_limitations: Exact original source regions are preserved at native or integer nearest scale; enlarged small labels retain original pixel detail. Fidelity audit does not independently validate scientific conclusions.
